registration.if_rejected: the folder is removed and the lead is recorded as a findings entry under Research Article/gate2_C2_england_2025, keeping the observation without keeping a register identifier

question.proposition: Cd177 detection in a transitional alveolar cell carries information about that cell beyond the information carried by its position in the transcriptional landscape.
question.what_is_not_being_asked: whether a primed, identity-retaining transitional state exists, which the England package already describes, and whether CD177-positive cells are functionally distinct, which no RNA matrix can answer
question.what_is_being_asked: the attribution of one marker: cell-intrinsic programme against positional coordinate, holding the frozen transitional gate and module definitions fixed

exposure.detail: The founding within-subcluster result (FU_C) was computed and seen on 28 September 2026 before this contract was written, and Stage 1 reuses the same processed matrices. Stage 1 is an amendment with full prior exposure, not independent confirmation.
exposure.consequence: Stage 1 is one-directional: it can close the question negatively, and its strongest permitted positive conclusion is bounded by stage_1_permitted_positive_conclusion below.

founding_observation.why_not: reuse never adds independent evidence; the England package owns these numbers and the interpretation recorded there, and A16 opens with a question about them rather than support for an answer

libraries_with_the_contrast.note: the only two libraries in GSE247505 with enough Cd177-positive transitional cells; same experiment, no animal identities deposited, therefore not two biological replicates

founding_observation.depth_control: all seven associations keep their sign under the three methods available in both libraries; residualisation on log depth and detected genes retains 87 to 159 per cent of each effect; the frozen four-method rule returned inconclusive only because 3,000-UMI thinning leaves GSM7890836 at 26 positive cells, below the pre-set 30-cell floor
founding_observation.marker_quality: Cd177 UMIs in positive cells spread 1 to 53 with no break, so the positive/negative split is a detection threshold rather than a bimodal population

frozen_definitions.transitional_gate: Cldn4, Ndrg1, Sox9; at least two of three detected
frozen_definitions.source_of_truth: Research Article/gate2_C2_england_2025/config/continuation_contract.json; not to be varied by this question
frozen_definitions.primary_endpoint: priming-associated RNA, the only endpoint that survived conditioning in the founding work
frozen_definitions.secondary_endpoints: the remaining six, reported for consistency and not promoted if they move

unit_and_inference.unit: the sequencing library; never the cell and never a pooled two-library aggregate
unit_and_inference.consequence: no population inference, no p values, no significance statement; per-library reporting only
unit_and_inference.floor: at least 30 cells per side; a stratum below the floor is reported as not assessed

A16_C1_continuous_neighbourhood_matching.purpose: condition on position continuously instead of on arbitrary cluster boundaries
A16_C1_continuous_neighbourhood_matching.estimand: weighted mean matched difference in the primary endpoint per library, over a prespecified range of k
A16_C1_continuous_neighbourhood_matching.decision: inside the C3 null band means the residual is composition finer than the round-2 clusters and A16 closes; outside means position as measured does not explain it

A16_C2_resolution_ladder.purpose: test whether the residual is an artefact of one clustering resolution
A16_C2_resolution_ladder.estimand: trend of the pooled within-subcluster primary effect against clustering resolution, with the count of subclusters clearing the floor at each
A16_C2_resolution_ladder.decision: monotone decay toward zero favours finer-scale composition; a plateau favours a non-positional component; running out of testable subclusters is reported as underpowered

A16_C3_detection_matched_gene_null.purpose: the specificity anchor: is the residual specific to Cd177 or generic gradient behaviour
A16_C3_detection_matched_gene_null.estimand: Cd177's primary effect as a quantile of a control-gene distribution matched on detection rate and mean expression within the transitional gate, per library and per analysis
A16_C3_detection_matched_gene_null.decision: central mass means the persistence is generic, the premise collapses and A16 closes; only an extreme-tail position keeps it open

A16_C4_ambient_neutrophil_origin_control.purpose: Cd177 is a neutrophil surface protein and the priming module is inflammation-associated, so ambient neutrophil RNA would produce a residual with no cell state behind it
A16_C4_ambient_neutrophil_origin_control.estimand: the primary effect before and after conditioning on a neutrophil and ambient panel score, plus the association between Cd177 detection and that score
A16_C4_ambient_neutrophil_origin_control.decision: removal of the residual means contamination and A16 closes negatively; this bears on the RNA side only and cannot touch the source's immunofluorescence or sorted-organoid evidence
A16_C4_ambient_neutrophil_origin_control.known_weakness: the deposit holds filtered matrices with no empty droplets, so ambient RNA cannot be estimated properly; a within-cell panel is a weaker instrument and a negative result here does not exclude contamination

A16_C5_threshold_and_marker_quality.purpose: the positive call is a cut on a continuum
A16_C5_threshold_and_marker_quality.estimand: sign and magnitude of the primary effect at Cd177 >= 1, >= 2 and >= 3 UMIs and at thinned-depth equivalents, with surviving cell counts
A16_C5_threshold_and_marker_quality.decision: sign changes across thresholds mean no RNA-based attribution is possible and the question waits entirely on protein

stage_1_permitted_positive_conclusion: a component of the priming association is not explained by position as measured here, is specific to Cd177 among detection-matched genes, and is not removed by the available ambient control — this wording is the ceiling, and cell-intrinsic function may not be concluded because conditioning shrinks the estimate under both rivals

stage_2_eligibility_gate.purpose: a later session cannot relax the readout requirement in order to obtain a testable dataset

conditions.1_protein_separation: CD177 measured as protein and used for prospective separation, by sorting or spatial protein at single-cell resolution; RNA detection alone is not separation
conditions.2_measured_outcome: EdU or BrdU incorporation, Ki67 protein, clone or colony growth, organoid formation, or a lineage label, on the separated fractions; a cycling RNA score is not an outcome
conditions.3_independent_state_assignment: transitional-state assignment by the frozen gate or an author label with a stated definition, so the comparison is within state
conditions.4_biological_replication: at least three independent animals or donors per arm with unit identities deposited
conditions.5_position_recoverable: enough transcriptome to establish neighbourhood, so separated cells are compared within a region rather than across the landscape

stop_rules.hard: if conditions 1 to 3 do not co-occur, no transfer is attempted and the search is recorded as a negative result
stop_rules.soft: a deposit meeting 1 and 2 but failing 4 may be used for an explicitly non-inferential descriptive transfer, labelled as such, and may not change the readiness row

stage_2_eligibility_gate.state_on_2026_09_28: no candidate clears conditions 1 and 2 together; GSE253461 and GSE316244 are partially eligible for the positional part of the question only and neither carries a sorted-CD177 arm with an outcome

rivals: finer-scale composition below the round-2 clusters
generic gradient behaviour shared by any detection-matched gene, the rival most likely to be correct
ambient neutrophil RNA co-varying with both Cd177 and the inflammation-associated priming module
a detection threshold masquerading as a population, given Cd177 UMIs spread 1 to 53 with no break
library-specific biology or handling, the two libraries already disagreeing on cycling
state-definition dependence of the transitional gate, disclosed rather than tested
RNA detection is not surface protein availability, which is what a sorting experiment would act on
prohibitions: do not report the England FU_C result as independent confirmation
do not treat a surviving within-neighbourhood association as cell-intrinsic function
do not substitute a cycling RNA score for a proliferation readout
do not pool GSM7890835 and GSM7890836
do not lower the 30-cell floor or relax the transitional gate to make a subcluster testable
do not change the gate or module definitions frozen in the England continuation contract
do not compute a trajectory, velocity or pseudotime; the source ran none and the deposit has no spliced or unspliced layers
do not use the Il1r1-deletion Cd177 decrease as evidence about attribution
do not add or regrade a claim row

boundaries.A8: owns the maturation component and mature AT1 endpoints; A16 does not ask what the primed state matures into
boundaries.A11: owns lesion programmes against shared plasticity; A16 uses the disjoint modules only as endpoints
boundaries.A1: owns the regulatory distinction between RNA-similar transitional states; A16 adds no chromatin or regulatory layer
boundaries.A4: owns lineage; nothing here traces a cell or licenses a direction
boundaries.A17: shares a package of origin and no data or estimand

discriminating_experiment.design: sort surface CD177-positive and CD177-negative cells from within a Cldn4/Ndrg1/Sox9 transitional gate in the same animals and from a comparable neighbourhood, and measure EdU or Ki67 protein and short-term clone growth on both fractions
discriminating_experiment.prediction_on_record: enrichment for primed, identity-retaining cells and not for more cycling ones
discriminating_experiment.falsifier: CD177-positive cells dividing more would contradict our reading and support the source's
